Citation

Inline superscript citations, citation blocks with source info, hover previews, and numbered reference lists for AI responses.

Inline Superscript

Superscript citation numbers within text.

React Server Components allow you to write components that run exclusively on the server.[1] They provide direct backend access and automatic code splitting.[2] This architecture is ideal for content-heavy applications.[3]

HTML
React Server Components allow you to write components that run exclusively on the server.
<a class="zak-ai-cite" href="#cite-1">[1]</a>

They provide direct backend access and automatic code splitting.
<a class="zak-ai-cite" href="#cite-2">[2]</a>

Citation Block

Full citation block with title, URL, and snippet.

1
React Docs: Server Components
react.dev/learn/server-components
Server Components are a new type of component that runs exclusively on the server. They allow you to access backend resources directly.
2
Next.js: App Router Documentation
nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application
The App Router supports React Server Components by default, providing automatic code splitting and server-side rendering.
3
Vercel: RSC Performance Guide
vercel.com/blog/react-server-components
Content-heavy applications benefit most from RSC as they can eliminate client-side JavaScript for static content rendering.
HTML
<div class="zak-ai-cite-list">
    <div class="zak-ai-cite-block" id="cite-1">
        <div class="zak-ai-cite-block-num">1</div>
        <div class="zak-ai-cite-block-body">
            <div class="zak-ai-cite-block-title">
                <a href="#">React Docs: Server Components</a>
            </div>
            <div class="zak-ai-cite-block-url">react.dev/learn/server-components</div>
            <div class="zak-ai-cite-block-snippet">
                Server Components are a new type of component...
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

Citation with Highlight

Highlighted quote block with a left accent border.

</div>

CSS Classes

HTML
.zak-ai-cite                   /* Inline superscript citation link */
.zak-ai-cite-block             /* Citation block container */
.zak-ai-cite-block-num         /* Numbered badge */
.zak-ai-cite-block-body        /* Title + URL + snippet */
.zak-ai-cite-block-title       /* Source title */
.zak-ai-cite-block-url         /* Source URL */
.zak-ai-cite-block-snippet     /* Text snippet (with mark highlighting) */
.zak-ai-cite-list              /* Vertical list of citation blocks */
.zak-ai-cite-preview           /* Hover preview wrapper */
.zak-ai-cite-preview-popup     /* Popup tooltip on hover */
.zak-ai-cite-preview-title     /* Popup title */
.zak-ai-cite-preview-url       /* Popup URL */
.zak-ai-cite-preview-snippet   /* Popup snippet */
.zak-ai-cite-highlight         /* Highlighted quote with accent border */
.zak-ai-cite-inline            /* Compact inline citation chip */
